text:
Carlos Vega: Urgent heads-up  foster agency called, possible short-term placement next week. Need to switch to emergency family leave ASAP. Whats the fastest way to file and keep payroll/benefits intact?

Michelle (People Ops): Oh wow, glad you told us. First step: file an "amend existing leave" or "new parental leave - emergency" in the HR portal and attach the agency placement letter. That flags payroll and benefits. If you can upload today we can fast-track.

Carlos Vega: I can get the placement letter tonight. Do we have an emergency backfill policy? Teams in hiring freeze.

Sam (People Ops): We have an emergency backfill fund for urgent family leaves. Hiring freeze exceptions allowed for short-term contractors up to 8 weeks. Paste a one-paragraph justification here and well triage approval within 48h.

Carlos Vega: Draft: "Carlos Vega requesting 6-week emergency leave for short-term foster placement (expected start May 18). Request a 6-week contract SRE/devops to cover oncall and deploys. Estimated cost $9k."

Lena Ortiz: +1 from manager. Will add manager sign-off when you submit the funding form. Also recommend blocking non-critical releases during first 2 weeks.

Benefits-Bot: Policy note: Emergency family leave is eligible if placement documentation provided. Paid top-up depends on tenure and prior leave usage. Childcare subsidy not applicable for foster placement until legal guardianship established. Link: https://handbook.internal/leaves#emergency

Carlos Vega: Net-pay concern: Im mid-cycle for bonus. Will leave affect calibration?

Michelle (People Ops): You can request review deferral. We annotate calibration docs to exclude leave periods from performance decisions. Add a note in the review form "defer due to approved emergency family leave".

Sam (People Ops): Payroll note: if you elect supplemental top-up now we can process the first paid week retroactively. Send me a DM to confirm election. If unpaid weeks occur well set up retro pay adjustments.

Carlos Vega: DM sent, elected top-up.

IT-Support: Quick ops: if youll need to keep the laptop for agency calls, submit the IT retention form. If you want us to provision a caregiver hotspot we can do that for up to 30 days.

Carlos Vega: Yes please keep the device. Ill submit the IT form and copy People Ops.

Michelle (People Ops): For contractor access: restrict to scoped service account and rotate CI tokens before handoff. Include that in the funding justification so IT can pre-provision.

Lena Ortiz: Ill draft the handoff checklist. Key items: pager escalation playbook, deploy rollback steps, list of active infra PRs, CI token rotation plan.

Carlos Vega: One more: can I request a payroll advance for emergency expenses (travel + temporary childcare)?

Sam (People Ops): Yes, use Payroll Advance. Submit the Advance Request and include receipts within 30 days. We can push a one-time advance up to $3k with manager sign-off. Paste estimate and Ill fast-track.

Carlos Vega: Requesting $2k advance for travel and immediate supplies.

Sam (People Ops): Pre-approved pending manager sign-off. Manager approved in thread. Ill create the advance request and DM confirmation.

Facilities: For housing the temporary caregiver during on-site visits, submit Visitor Request. For longer-term parking or badge access for agency staff, Facilities needs ID and visit dates.

Carlos Vega: Agency will need one-day badge twice a week for the next 2 weeks. Ill submit Visitor Request and tag Facilities.

IT-Support: Noted. Well prepare a scoped service account, ephemeral VPN token, and a short onboarding doc for the contractor. Plan to rotate prod keys on handoff day.

Michelle (People Ops): Timeline summary: - Today: upload placement letter + file leave (Carlos) - Within 24h: Sam starts payroll/top-up and advance - Within 48h: funding request submitted + manager sign-off - By May 15: contractor offer if approved - May 18: expected placement start + 1-week shadowing/hand-off

Carlos Vega: Thank you everyone. Ill upload docs now and post the funding form link when done. Really appreciate the speed on this.

Lena Ortiz: We got you. Ill freeze non-critical releases for May 18-31 and post the updated schedule.

Sam (People Ops): Advance created and DM sent. Follow up if you dont see it in payroll in 48h.

Carlos Vega: Advance received in payroll. Uploading placement letter now. Thank you all :heart:
